Today, Apple published a carousel post on its Instagram account featuring photos commissioned from Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito, showcasing the camera capabilities of the new iPhone Duo. Details below.

Apple shares six 'Shot on iPhone Duo' photos

For over a decade, Apple has used its 'Shot on iPhone' campaign to showcase the camera capabilities of each new iPhone.

From everyday users to renowned photographers and filmmakers, Apple has used the campaign to promote new lens hardware, shooting modes, and other iPhone-exclusive photography features.

The long-running campaign has also won multiple Cannes Lions awards, including two Grand Prix, and has been nominated twice for the Emmy Award for Outstanding Commercial.

Today, Apple posted a new carousel on Instagram showcasing the iPhone Duo, 'with a versatile camera system and a host of exciting new features.'

Below are the six photos taken by photographers Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito:

The iPhone Duo features a 48-megapixel rear camera, a 12-megapixel front camera, and a display-embedded FaceTime lens. Pre-orders begin this Friday, October 16, with shipping and in-store availability starting October 23.

Apple previously announced that customers can begin preparing their iPhone Duo pre-orders on October 12. More details can be found here.
